To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the continuous flow of a single solution into the separation space of an IEF device, which is based on a trapezoid‐shaped porous bed, can be used to separate and focus the zones of analytes with a resolution comparable with that of the classical discontinuous IEF.

a continuous single input divergent flow IFEF device can be successfully operated for long periods of time, and that the separation and focusing performance of the device is comparable to that of a conventional IEF system.
we have demonstrated the possibility of continuous separation of proteins by IEF with divergent flow in a trapezoid‐shaped separation space.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new method for preparative IEF, based on continuous divergent flow of a single solution through a porous bed with a trapezoid shape.
the development of a novel continuous divergent flow instrument for IEF with a single input.
the design, optimization and testing of the instrument for continuous diverging flow IEF with a single input for analytical and preparative applications.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the device has shown the suitability for the preparative analysis of complex mixtures.
this instrument is capable of performing continuous preparative IEF with high resolution.
the divergent flow IFEF device is suitable for preparative analysis and can be used for the separation of proteins with pI values in the range 4.0‐8.0.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a new type of preparative IEF instrument has been developed, which is based on a continuous flow of the single input solution into the separation space.
the device has been successfully tested and can be used for preparative analysis and separation of proteins.
a new instrument for continuous diverging flow IEF was designed, constructed and tested.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed instrument can be used for the analysis of proteins and peptides with a high throughput and high resolution, which makes it suitable for preparative analysis.
the divergent flow IEC device is capable of continuous separation and focusing of proteins in a preparative scale with the resolution comparable to the one of the conventional IEC devices.
the divergent flow IFEF can be successfully used for preparative analysis with the possibility of continuous separation of analytes.
